chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu Jamilah, from Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the salat over the جنازة when a man has missed from it one takbir, or two, or three. He said: He pronounces the takbirs that he missed.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَةُ: a single utterance of takbir in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer, here specifically the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the deceased person or funeral over whom the prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he misses one or more takbirs in the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat over the deceased. If a person misses one or more takbirs in the funeral prayer, he should make up the takbirs that he missed.
